scripts.docker:build_app: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/app" -v "$(pwd)/dist-linux:/out" scp-linux-builder bash -c "npm install && npm run build && npx tauri build && cp -r src-tauri/target/release/bundle/* /out/ && echo '✅ Build artifacts copied to dist-linux/'"
scripts.docker:helper:release: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/app" scp-linux-builder bash -lc "cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin supercontrolpanelhelper"
